commits: 3D-91: ringArea, ringIsClockwise with unit tests; status review
finalText:
3D-91 is finished and pushed to `wp/3d-91-ring-utils`. I did **not** do 3D-92 on this branch.

**Why I skipped 3D-92:** our rules (`AGENTS.md` §2, rule 3) require one work package per branch, per PR and per session. I asked you whether to make an exception, but the question went unanswered. So I took the option that keeps the rules: 3D-92 stays `ready` and untouched. If you want the exception anyway, say so and I'll add it here and record it as decision `D-3D91-1`.

**3D-91:**
- I added `ringArea` and `ringIsClockwise` to `packages/geo-model3d/src/ring.js`, next to the existing `ringSignedArea`. All three are exported from the package.
- A ring with zero area counts as not clockwise.
- `test/ring.test.js` covers the unit square: area 1 and counter-clockwise, and reversed it is area 1 and clockwise. Both tests pass.
- `npm run check` (the full CI check) passes.
- I updated the package README and the 3D-91 checkpoint. The backlog row and diagram now show 3D-91 as `review`.
- I didn't open a PR, because our workflow only opens one when you ask.

**Next step for 3D-92:** start a fresh session on a new branch, `wp/3d-92-unit-constants`, from `claude/keen-pascal-u7z2gk`. It's tiny (`units.js` with `METRE` and `DEGREE`, plus a unit test) and needs no decisions. These handoff details are also in `.agent/checkpoints/3D-91.md`.
